purpose: Define a future ledger for tracking source usefulness for resolution and source-capture quality only.
forbidden_future_uses: no trade profit as sole source quality score
no edge, EV, probability, or confidence scoring
source_quality_principles: A source should not be rewarded merely because a trade was profitable.
A source should be reviewed for alignment with final resolution outcomes.
A source should be reviewed for timeliness relative to resolution/source capture needs.
A source should be reviewed according to official/source hierarchy.
A source should be reviewed for contradiction rate and misleading history.
A source should be reviewed for usefulness in rules/source capture and operator review.
